title: Higher-order representations depend on prefrontal and parietal cortex

statements.text: First-order perceptual representations depend on activity in early sensory regions, and higher-order representations depend mainly on activity in prefrontal and parietal cortex. The higher-order view by itself does not fix this anatomy, but Lau and Rosenthal adopt it as its neural interpretation.
